data.name: Sunil
data.gender_notes: Sunil is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit su, 'good, very', + nīla, 'blue' — 'very blue'. Its root is Sanskrit su + nīla. A classical Sanskrit name. Sunil is a Sanskrit name meaning “Very blue; dark blue; sapphire”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sunil expresses “Very blue; dark blue; sapphire”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit su, 'good, very', + nīla, 'blue' — 'very blue'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sunil total 21, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
